# Quick reference {.unnumbered}

Two tables for when you need a specific answer fast. The first maps common reviewer comments to the chapter that addresses them. The second maps figure problems to the chapters that cover them.

New to research? Start with [why writing matters](01-why-writing.qmd) and [clear writing](03-clear-writing.qmd), and keep the [glossary](glossary.qmd) open for any unfamiliar term. When you are ready to submit, run down the [checklists](checklists.qmd).

## If your reviewer said…

| Reviewer comment | Where to look |
|:----------------|:-------------|
| "The abstract doesn't state the main finding" | [Article structure](02-article-structure.qmd), abstracts |
| "The introduction is too long / too broad" | [Article structure](02-article-structure.qmd), the introduction |
| "The key result is buried in a subordinate clause" | [Clear writing](03-clear-writing.qmd), stress position |
| "You report p-values without confidence intervals" | [Presenting data](04-presenting-data.qmd), reporting numbers |
| "Your methods and results use different terminology" | [Statistical writing](statistical-writing.qmd) |
| "The sensitivity analysis contradicts your primary result" | [Statistical writing](statistical-writing.qmd), discordant sensitivity analysis |
| "You don't discuss what happens when data are missing" | [Statistical writing](statistical-writing.qmd), the missing-data paragraph |
| "I couldn't tell what the figure shows without reading the methods" | [Captions](13-captions.qmd) |
| "Your y-axis doesn't start at zero" | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd), truncated y-axis |
| "Colours are indistinguishable to colour-blind readers" | [Colour](14-colour.qmd), colour-vision deficiency |
| "The figure contradicts the results text" | [Presenting data](04-presenting-data.qmd), text/table/figure agreement |
| "Too many pie charts" | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd), pie chart |
| "The figure uses a rainbow palette" | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd) / [Colour](14-colour.qmd), sequential palettes |
| "I can't find the dataset or analysis code" | [Open science](open-science.qmd); [Reproducibility](reproducibility.qmd) |
| "The citation doesn't say what you say it says" | [Reference management](07-reference-management.qmd), citation hygiene |
| "I'm not sure who actually wrote this" | [AI in writing](ai-writing.qmd) |
| "Ghost authorship / I can't identify the contribution" | [Co-authorship](08-co-authorship.qmd), CRediT |
| "The reporting checklist item is incomplete" | [Reporting guidelines](06-reporting-guidelines.qmd) |
| "The English is non-native but the argument is unclear" | [Writing in a second language](writing-l2.qmd) |

## If your figure fails at…

| Problem | Where to look |
|:--------|:-------------|
| Choosing the right chart type for your data | [Chart types](11-chart-types.qmd) |
| A palette that is not perceptually uniform | [Colour](14-colour.qmd), sequential palettes / CVD |
| An incomplete or under-specified caption | [Captions](13-captions.qmd) |
| Bars that don't start at zero | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd), truncated y-axis |
| Too many categories in one panel | [Colour](14-colour.qmd), categorical palettes (max 8) |
| File format or resolution for journal submission | [Colour](14-colour.qmd), preparing figures for submission |
| Dual-axis confusion | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd), dual-axis line chart |
| Mean ± SE bars hiding the distribution | [Pitfalls](12-pitfalls.qmd), mean ± SE bars |
| Code-generated figure with unverified values | [AI for figures](15-ai-figures.qmd), code-generation tools |
